events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 2 | From Alejandro G. Iñárritu (The Revenant, Birdman): The most powerful man in the world (Tom Cruise) embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

events.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
events.description: OPENS SEPT. 25 | Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

events.title: The History of Concrete
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 2 | Filmmaker Jon Wilson applies lessons from a Hallmark movie writing workshop to pitch a documentary about concrete. A surreal, hysterical, and relatable film about America's favorite building material.

events.title: You Had to Be There
